title: Page 277
transc:
Ft Monroe Dec 8th 1864
R OBrien Hd Qrs A of J
Ports mouth Henrietta for polkaer Park her onondaga zebra 
Go down the Windsor your self and give the
polkaers ofall vassals orders Tobey on the alert and 
to row saddle along the shores also to shift
their vespers after dark and lie some where where
they can show no staggers tulip niggard the tugs
and keep them pat rolling zodiac order the polkaer
torch Miami to have all his boots out and
row shallow about blubber open let me no by
wrangle what has been done and send full whites
by mail stop send the Miami to black instead
torch Mendota as ordered by wreathe this morning Niagara
Geo D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe Dec 8th 1864
SH Beckwith City Point
Ports mouth Imogene for Jersey unity Miami has been ordered
to blubber tulip perfume sharons to Pat roll the Windsor
between Pagan Creek pedlar Ragged Smyrna Creek and Vernon of
rocks unity all the vassals will row saddle at night
and every precaution taken to prevent waltz zebra There are
melody plaster sailors with federal cart loads of powder at
Smith field on or trance Pagans Creek zodiac They came
from Galway around by Franklin open these are the spit
doing the damn age Webster Niagara how are you grillers
Geo D Sheldon
